blocks.text:
Arrival at Rio de Janeiro Airport. You will be met by your guide at the airport.* Transfer to the hotel. 

On the way to the hotel, our guide will briefly tell you about the city, answer your questions, and help with currency exchange or buying a local SIM card. Also, during the entire vacation, we and our guides are ready to fulfill any of your requests!

If you arrive before dawn, you will see green hills, rocky mountains, palm trees on both sides of the road and beautiful bays on the way from the airport. At nightfall, the city is surrounded by a shimmering necklace - these are the lights of the favelas! You can spend the rest of the day at your discretion. Maybe someone will want to see and feel the exuberant life of the city as soon as possible. And someone wants to be alone with themselves, then there is always a corner for this somewhere between palm trees, sand and ocean waves.

*if you wish, you can take the Fast Track Gold service

In the evening, we advise you to dine in the restaurant of your Belmond Copacabana Palace hotel with a Michelin star - Cipriani

blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. A guide awaits you in the lobby of the hotel. 

Half-day excursion to Sugarloaf (Pao de Azucar Mountain) with an English-speaking guide. You go to Praia Vermelha (Red Beach), from where you will take a cable car up the mountain. The first stop will be on Mount Urka, which has a wide observation deck where you can have a snack in a restaurant or bar. On Sugarloaf Mountain itself, there is a smaller platform, but it offers a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains, islands in the ocean, the Niterói Bridge, and the statue of Christ.

Then by car you will go to the central areas of old Rio, where you will admire several ancient churches, monasteries, the main Cathedral of the city, as well as buildings built in the colonial style. 

*Sugarloaf VIP Access enabled

We recommend lunch at the Fogo do Chao restaurant (meat, Brazilian shurasco) with stunning views of Sugarloaf 

In the evening, we recommend having dinner at the Al Mare (seafood) restaurant, which is located on the Copacabana waterfront in the chic Fasano Hotel
